cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(JudasWindowsDependencyContract LANGUAGES C CXX)
if(NOT MSVC OR NOT WIN32 OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "This contract requires native MSVC x64")
endif()
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>DLL")
set(SDL2_DISABLE_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLM_BUILD_INSTALL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
include("${JUDAS_SOURCE_ROOT}/cmake/JudasWindowsDependencies.cmake")
judas_windows_dependencies()
add_executable(dependency_probe consumer.cpp)
target_link_libraries(dependency_probe PRIVATE SDL2::SDL2 glm::glm)
